blocks.text: TOKYO — A US Marine died after an incident during training in Japan’s Okinawa, a 3rd Marine Division spokesman told AFP on Thursday. “The incident took place on November 3,” spokesman Sebastian RiveraAponte said, confirming the death of the Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab on the southern island. READ: US Marine indicted over robbery, murder of woman in Okinawa The cause “is still under investigation”, he said, declining to disclose further details.
